plan.title: Repoint preamble, rules pack, and agents-entry from the Python gate to the Go gate

narratives.Description: The DEFT-PREAMBLE in main.md, the main-001 rule in the rules pack, and content/templates/agents-entry.md all currently mandate the Python `run gate` invocation. This story repoints every load-bearing gate citation at the Go gate and scrubs setup/sync skills and CONTRIBUTING for stale `run` operator paths that already have a replacement.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
- Edit the main.md DEFT-PREAMBLE source and the main-001 rule in the rules-pack config so they invoke the Go gate instead of `python3 .deft/core/run gate`.
- Refresh content/templates/agents-entry.md and run `task agents:refresh` so the consumer AGENTS.md is regenerated, then verify with an encoding test that no mojibake was introduced.
- Grep the setup/sync skill files and CONTRIBUTING for stale `run` citations and redirect each one that has a replacement.
narratives.UserStory: As an agent reading the deft guidelines, I want the preamble and rules pack to invoke the Go gate, so that I do not depend on a Python run shim that is about to be deleted.

items.title: Given main.md, when an agent follows the DEFT-PREAMBLE, then it invokes the Go gate and no longer shows `python3 .deft/core/run gate`.

narrative.Acceptance: Given main.md, when an agent follows the DEFT-PREAMBLE, then it invokes the Go gate and no longer shows `python3 .deft/core/run gate`.
